SELECT c.club_number as clubNumber, c.status, f.festival_number as festivalNumber , f.festival_name as festivalName, c.club_name as clubName, c.purpose, a.account_number as accountNumber, a.nickname, c.created_at as createdAt FROM clubs c JOIN festivals f ON f.FESTIVAL_NUMBER = c.FESTIVAL_NUMBER JOIN attendees atd ON atd.CLUB_NUMBER = c.CLUB_NUMBER AND atd.attendee_role = 0 JOIN accounts a ON a.ACCOUNT_NUMBER = atd.ACCOUNT_NUMBER
AND c.status = #{query.filterByStatus}
AND c.purpose = #{query.filterByPurpose}
AND c.club_name LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(#{query.keyword}, '!', '!!'),'%', '!%'),'_', '!_'), '%') ESCAPE '!'
AND f.festival_name LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(#{query.keyword}, '!', '!!'),'%', '!%'),'_', '!_'), '%') ESCAPE '!'
AND a.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(#{query.keyword}, '!', '!!'),'%', '!%'),'_', '!_'), '%') ESCAPE '!'
AND 1 = 0

SELECT c.club_number AS clubNumber,c.status,c.club_name AS clubName,c.meeting_date AS meetingDate, c.created_at AS createdAt,f.festival_number AS festivalNumber,f.festival_name AS festivalName, c.contents,c.purpose, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendees atd WHERE atd.club_number = c.club_number ) AS curCount, c.max_count AS maxCount FROM clubs c JOIN festivals f ON f.festival_number = c.festival_number WHERE c.club_number = #{clubNumber}

SELECT a.account_number as accountNumber, a.NICKNAME, atd.ATTENDEE_ROLE as attendeeRole FROM accounts a JOIN attendees atd ON atd.ACCOUNT_NUMBER = a.ACCOUNT_NUMBER JOIN clubs c ON c.CLUB_NUMBER = atd.CLUB_NUMBER WHERE c.CLUB_NUMBER = #{clubNumber};
mapper.update: UPDATE clubs SET STATUS = #{status} WHERE club_number = #{clubNumber};
